Specification: This module specifies a small two-variable transition system with integer variable x and boolean variable y. Action A toggles y and increments x while x < 4, and action B toggles y and resets x from 4 back to 1, yielding a cyclic behavior under Next == A \/ B. The specification defines both an unfaired behavior Spec and a weakly fair behavior FairSpec, checks an invariant Inv asserting x < 4, and a temporal property Prop asserting eventual x > 4, which is intentionally violated. The module also defines an Alias operator used by TLC to present reordered and augmented state views, plus postconditions that validate the exact counterexample traces produced by TLC in simulation, lasso, and stuttering scenarios.

No Init-prefixed operator is defined in this module.
Alias contains ENABLED Next, but it also contains primed variables x' and is record-valued rather than a state predicate, so it is not placed in StatePredicate.

PostCondition, PostConditionLasso, and PostConditionStuttering are Boolean-valued but contain primed variables nowhere and no temporal operators; they are classified in ValueDef by elimination because they are TLC postcondition/helper definitions rather than ordinary state predicates over the current state.
Animation and vars are placed in ValueDef as non-Boolean helper/value definitions.
FairSpec is placed in TemporalProperty because it conjoins Spec with WF_vars(Next), making it a temporal specification.
FunctionConstructor_SetType is empty; all FunctionConstructor entries are [x \in S |-> e] forms.
TemporalNesting is false. No temporal operator appears explicitly nested inside another temporal operator in this file; Tautology uses ~> only as top-level shorthand.
